expense.title: Expense
expense.description: An individual expense transaction recorded by a member.

member.description: The member who made the expense.

date.description: The date of the expense in YYYY-MM-DD format.

time.description: The time of the expense (HH:mm or ISO).

itemName.description: Optional name of the item purchased.

place.description: Optional place where the expense occurred.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Monthly budget settings for the group or individual members.

key.description: Unique key for the budget (e.g., '2026-08' or 'Nimal_2026-08').

month.description: The month the budget applies to in YYYY-MM format.

member.description: Optional member the budget belongs to.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

avatar.title: Member Avatar
avatar.description: Custom avatar photo or URL for a roommate.

member.description: The member whose avatar is being set.

avatarUrl.description: Base64 data URL or external image URL for the avatar.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the avatar was last updated.
